Other staff, such as ACPs and nurses are also just as lovely and knowledgable and caring.

The system of urgent/non-urgent appointments works perfectly if you're calling on a morning. I know some people have issues with this but you don't have to divulge your whole symptom list and history, you can simply summerise the issue. You can also sometimes book appointments through the NHS app or by their contact form. I have also been actively contacted regarding my health which is so so rare and so so appreciated.

When I had an issue my GP couldn't answer, he passed me onto the practice manager who was able to resolve it, and answered my questions regarding it with a friendly tone. In fact, all and any questions I've had have been answered in a friendly and helpful way. Referrals are processed swiftly and according to guidelines. I had a blood test and the results came back in 24 hours. All of this not even to mention the building is amazing, there's a library nearby and so is ASDA. The waiting room seats are comfy, one time there was magazines.

I have honestly zero complaints and the reviews saying elsewise are weird.
